description: This PHP class defines a display field for skills within the OrangeHRM reporting system. It extends a base display field class, specifying associated DTO class, entity aliases, and relevant database fields for report generation.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: Represents a display field for Skills in the OrangeHRM reporting system, providing DTO class information, entity aliases, and report fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the DTO associated with the Skill display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in report query building.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields relevant to this display field.
